title: DataCompleteness
description: ISO 25012-sourced data quality archetype — Completeness inherent data quality characteristic. The degree to which subject data associated with an entity has values for all expected attributes and related entity instances in a specific context of use. Rootless archetype — used as qualifier in Directives/Norms governing data entities. Source: ISO/IEC 25012 (Inherent Data Quality — Completeness).

completenessLevel.description: Required level of data completeness. MINIMAL = only key fields required. PARTIAL = core attributes required. SUBSTANTIAL = most attributes required. COMPLETE = all attributes must be populated.

mandatoryFieldCoverage.description: Target percentage of mandatory fields that must be populated (0-100).

nullHandlingPolicy.description: Policy for handling missing/null values in data records.
